== NAME

xref-custom-caption-content - formatted caption references

== DESCRIPTION

Forward: xref:custom[xrefstyle=short] / xref:custom[xrefstyle=full] / xref:custom[].

[#custom,caption='{caption-word}. ']
.An _example_
====
Body.
====

:caption-word: *Later*
:example-caption: Changed

Backward: xref:custom[xrefstyle=short] / xref:custom[xrefstyle=full].

[#table,caption='*Table prefix*. ']
.A table
|===
|Cell
|===

Table: xref:table[xrefstyle=short] / xref:table[xrefstyle=full].

[#listing,caption='*Code prefix*. ']
.A listing
----
code
----

Listing: xref:listing[xrefstyle=short] / xref:listing[xrefstyle=full].

[#punctuation,caption='*Keep.* ']
.Styled period
====
Body.
====

Punctuation: xref:punctuation[xrefstyle=short] / xref:punctuation[xrefstyle=full].

[#raw,caption='*Raw* pass:[.] ']
.Separate suffix
====
Body.
====

Raw suffix: xref:raw[xrefstyle=short] / xref:raw[xrefstyle=full].

[#raw-role,caption='[.underline]++Keep. ++']
.Attributed raw suffix
====
Body.
====

Raw role: xref:raw-role[xrefstyle=short] / xref:raw-role[xrefstyle=full].

[#labelled,caption='*Unused*. ',reftext='Chosen _label_']
.A title
====
Body.
====

Label: xref:labelled[xrefstyle=short] / xref:labelled[xrefstyle=full].

[#nested,caption='*See* xref:custom[]. ']
.Nested reference
====
Body.
====

Nested: xref:nested[xrefstyle=short] / xref:nested[xrefstyle=full].

[#linked,caption='*Visit* https://example.org[site]. ']
.External link
====
Body.
====

Linked: xref:linked[xrefstyle=short] / xref:linked[xrefstyle=full].

[#registered,caption='[#caption-mark]*Mark* footnote:caption-note[One note]. ']
.Registered content
====
Body.
====

Registered: xref:registered[xrefstyle=short] / xref:registered[xrefstyle=full].

Buffered: ^xref:custom[xrefstyle=short]^.
